packageRules.description: Actions: one PR for minor, patch and digest updates
Core and Periphery run the same version
Collector (Salt) and analyzer image (stacks/) are released together
Release assets are verified by sha256 in defaults.yaml, Renovate cannot fill them in
prBodyNotes: Add the sha256 of every release asset to `defaults.yaml` in this PR before merging, otherwise `source_hash` fails.
Check that the release builds against the gateway kernels (comment in `systemd-networkd/init.sls`) and move the old version to `batman_old_versions`.

customManagers.description: Versions in Salt states and defaults, marked with a `renovate:` comment on the line above
